{{Top|leg}}
'''Micropower routers''' were power components used in [[Atgar SpaceDefense Corporation/Legends|Atgar SpaceDefense Corporation's]] [[1.4 FD P-Tower/Legends|1.4 FD P-Tower]]. Sixteen of them were evenly spaced around the weapon's high energy dish; as part of the cannon's firing process, all sixteen had to be charged directly from the internal [[C-6 battery]] along with eight [[energy conversion cell]]s. A malfunction in any of the sixteen routers caused the weapon to fail and become disabled.<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>
